name: Premier Umalas 16 — Stylish 3BR Pool Townhouse
description: Premier Umalas 16 is a three-bedroom townhouse in the quiet lanes of Umalas, between Canggu and Seminyak, finished in dark stone and warm wood. Each bedroom has its own en-suite bathroom and a desk by the window; the enclosed living room and the kitchen with its island are air-conditioned, and glass doors open onto a private pool and a small planted courtyard. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps, and with three separate workspaces the house is set up for people staying for months as much as for a holiday. Washing machine, safe and iron are on site. Sleeps 6.

name: Premier Umalas 17 — Stylish 2BR Private Pool Home
Villa Black Pool — Family 4BR Villa with Big Pool
description: Spacious modern 4-bedroom villa in Sanur with a private black-tiled pool, tropical garden, open living spaces and walking distance to the beach, cafés and shops.

name: Stylish 2BR Pool Townhouse in Sanur
description: Modern 2-bedroom townhouse in Sanur, about 15 minutes walk to the beach, with a private plunge pool, enclosed living room, full kitchen, fast Wi-Fi and two king bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms.

name: Modern 2BR Pool Townhouse in Sanur
description: New 110 m2 two-storey townhouse in a quiet part of Sanur, a 15-minute walk from the beach. Two en-suite king bedrooms (one with a workspace), a private enclosed pool and terrace, a Smart TV living room, a fully equipped kitchen, 300 Mbps Wi-Fi and housekeeping 3x a week. Ideal for families, couples and long-term stays.

name: Lucky Lily 3BR Pool Villa in Sanur
description: Spacious 3-bedroom private villa in Sanur with a large garden, private pool, BBQ area, fast Wi-Fi, dedicated workspace and family-friendly layout, about 7 minutes by scooter from Sanur Beach.

name: Villa Kesari 4 — Family 3BR Pool Villa in Sanur
description: Newly built 3-bedroom family villa on a quiet street in Sanur, a 10-minute walk from the beach. Private pool with a shallow area for children, tropical garden with sun loungers, and three en-suite bedrooms with A/C, blackout curtains and garden views. Open-plan living room with a dining area, fully equipped kitchen, 300 Mbps fibre Wi-Fi and a work-friendly desk. Housekeeping 3x a week, pool and garden care included. Free private parking with automatic gates; staff meet every guest in person.
amenities: Private pool with shallow kids' area

name: Villa The Wave — Beachside 6BR Villa in Canggu
description: Two-storey 341 m² villa built in 2023, a 2–5 minute walk from Berawa Beach in Canggu. Six bedrooms, each with a king bed, a TV and its own en-suite bathroom, plus a separate guest toilet. Open-plan living room with a Smart TV and fully equipped kitchen opening onto a large private pool through full-height glass doors; a wide first-floor balcony overlooks the garden. Fast Wi-Fi, a safe in every room and housekeeping three times a week are included. Sleeps up to 12 — suited to large families, groups of friends, weddings and company retreats.
amenities: Six king bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms

name: Sanur Garden Pool Villa — Family 4BR near Mertasari Beach
description: Two-storey 235 m² villa on a quiet lane in south Sanur, a short walk from local cafés and about a kilometre from Mertasari Beach. Four bedrooms — the master on the ground floor with a pool view, three more upstairs — each with a king bed and its own en-suite bathroom, plus a separate guest toilet. The enclosed living and kitchen area is air-conditioned, with a large sofa, Smart TV and a dining table for eight, and opens through sliding glass doors onto a 35 m² private pool with four sunbeds and a garden. Fast Wi-Fi, a dedicated workspace, filtered drinking water, private parking and housekeeping three times a week are included. Sleeps up to 8 — suited to families and to two or three families travelling together.
amenities: Private 35 m² pool with four sunbeds
Smart TV with Netflix and Apple TV

name: Eco Private — Teak 1BR Pool Villa in Ungasan
description: A one-bedroom villa in Ungasan on the Bukit peninsula, built almost entirely from natural teak and wrapped in tropical planting. Step out of the bedroom and you are at a private pool set in a garden; the air-conditioned living area with a Smart TV runs into a kitchen with a bar counter, and the bathroom has its own garden outlook and a free-standing tub. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps and there is a desk by the window, so the villa works for remote work as much as for a slow holiday. Scooter parking, housekeeping three times a week and a laundry pick-up service are included; the beaches of the south coast are around ten minutes away. Sleeps 2 — made for couples, solo travellers and long stays.
amenities: One bedroom with a double bed
Bathroom with garden view and free-standing tub

name: Eco Teak — 2BR Pool Villa in Ungasan
description: A two-bedroom villa in Ungasan built from natural teak, with its own pool, a lawn and two covered verandas. Both bedrooms have extra-wide two-metre beds, air conditioning and their own bathroom; the enclosed living room and fully equipped kitchen are air-conditioned as well, and the dining table looks straight out at the water. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps, so the villa suits remote work as much as a family holiday. Self check-in with a code lock, free scooter parking and housekeeping three times a week are included, and the beaches of the Bukit are about ten minutes away. Sleeps 4.
amenities: Two bedrooms with 2 m wide beds
Air conditioning in bedrooms and living room
Self check-in with a code lock

name: Eco Exclusive — Teak 1BR Pool Villa in Ungasan
description: A one-bedroom teak villa in a quiet Ungasan compound, with a private pool, a lawn and a bright open-plan interior. Bedroom, living area and the kitchen with its breakfast bar all sit under one pitched teak roof; the bathroom opens onto greenery and has a free-standing tub and a rain shower. Wi-Fi runs at 200 Mbps and there is a workspace and an in-room safe. Housekeeping three times a week, scooter parking and self check-in are included, and the beaches of the Bukit are about ten minutes away. Sleeps 2 — made for couples, solo travellers and long stays.
amenities: Bathroom with garden view and free-standing tub
